name: Asylum: Face of Janus
source:
You don’t know who, or even -what-, you are—and neither do your newfound “friends” who chased you down for research purposes. And yet you could be the key to reversing the new, dangerous changes to the world.

Solve the mystery—or doom everyone to what was a previously unimaginable fate in the world of Asylum.

You wake up, finding yourself a total stranger to the world of Asylum, a world filled with emptiness and despair, and recalling no more than your name. Chased like an animal, captured and tortured, you have to choose to either serve your captors or spend the rest of your life in dungeons…

…will you dare to trust them? Or try to find your own way in this world and achieve your revenge?

Solve the mystery awaiting you at the end - or die trying.  

[From [url=http://asylumvisualnovel.tumblr.com/storyline]official site[/url]]
translation:
你不知道自己是誰，甚至不知道自己是什麼——追捕你的新「朋友」也同樣不明白，他們只是為了研究而追蹤你。然而，你可能是逆轉世界新危險變化的關鍵。

解開謎團，否則Asylum世界將迎來過去無法想像的命運。

你醒來，發現自己對Asylum世界完全陌生。這裡充滿空虛與絕望，你只記得自己的名字。你像動物一樣被追捕、囚禁、拷打，必須選擇侍奉俘獲者，或在地牢度過餘生……

……你敢相信他們嗎？還是要在這個世界中尋找自己的道路，實現復仇？

解開等待在終點的謎團——否則在嘗試中死去。

［譯自[url=http://asylumvisualnovel.tumblr.com/storyline]官方網站[/url]］
